newsitem.title: UK: CWC tumbles on report of investment plans.
newsitem.headline: CWC tumbles on report of investment plans.

text.p: Shares in Cable and Wireless Communications Plc tumbled to a five-week low on Wednesday on a press report that said the group had been forced to cut its investment plans having failed to meet its profit targets, dealers said.
At 0745 GMT, the stock was down 17-1/2p to 289-1/2.
The Independent said Cable & Wireless Plc, which owns more than 50 percent of the company, ordered the cuts.

As a result, CWC - formed by the merger of the Mercury unit of Cable & Wireless with the British cable units of NYNEX Cable Comms, Bell Cablemedia Plc and Videotron - would reduce spending on the roll-out of cable infrastructure to homes.
Investment cuts also could hit CWC's plans to launch 200-channel digital television services later this year, the report said.
